stage0020_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$第３新東京市$$, Municipal Jr. High No. 1 ～

stage0020_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Sorry, transfer student.
　I've gotta hit you.
　It won't feel right otherwise」

stage0020_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$トウジ$$
「That you pilot that thing called an Eva,
　the whole school already knows that」

stage0020_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Sorry about this...
　His sister got hurt in that
　incident recently, see」

stage0020_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Well... that's just how it is」

stage0020_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...It's not like I wanted to pilot it either...」

stage0020_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$シンジ$$
（What part of this is something to be praised for...）

stage0020_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Just because I pilot an Eva,
　why do I get hit for it...）

stage0020_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$いぶき$$
「What happened, $$シンジ$$!?
　Your face...」

stage0020_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$谷川$$
「It's obviously not nothing!
　Your cheek's swollen and your lip's split!」

stage0020_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$大山$$
「If you don't want to talk, that's fine,
　but at least let me treat that」

stage0020_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$赤木$$
「Got in a fight, $$シンジ$$?
　Right after transferring, huh!」

stage0020_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$赤木$$
「I bet you two are going to be...」

stage0020_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$入江$$
「Just so you know, becoming best friends
　with someone you fought only happens in manga」

stage0020_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$青山$$
「Maybe you meant to cheer him up,
　but junior high kids won't buy that fantasy stuff」

stage0020_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm fine, $$赤木$$.
　I'm not bothered by it...」

stage0020_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$リツコ$$
「From what you told me, $$シンジ$$ changed
　after the fight against the $$ヘテロダイン$$, but...」

stage0020_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Seems like arranging for him
　to attend school backfired」

stage0020_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Never imagined he'd get hit by a classmate
　on his very first day transferring...」

stage0020_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$リツコ$$
「With daily training on top of it,
　I question sending him to school at all」

stage0020_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Maybe, but $$シンジ$$'s still a person.
　He has the right to enjoy a life of his own」

stage0020_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ミサト$$
「In fact, $$甲児$$ and $$ワッ太$$ and the others
　manage to balance school life
　with Crusher Team duties too」

stage0020_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$リツコ$$
「$$シンジ$$ isn't like them.
　For him, isn't school life itself the stress?」

stage0020_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$リツコ$$
「$$シンジ$$ might just have a personality
　not suited to making friends.
　...Do you know the Hedgehog's Dilemma?」

stage0020_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$リツコ$$
「With hedgehogs, even wanting to share
　your warmth with another, the closer you get
　the more your spines hurt each other...」

stage0020_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$リツコ$$
「The same holds true for people too.
　Right now, some part of $$シンジ$$ fears that pain
　and it's made him timid, I'd guess」

stage0020_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Well... he'll figure it out eventually.
　Growing up means repeating that push and pull
　till you find a distance that hurts you both least」

stage0020_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Where did $$甲児$$ and the others go?」

stage0020_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$青山$$
「$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ has supply issues too,
　so they've gone to the Far East Branch base in Izu」

stage0020_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$いぶき$$
「$$甲児$$ and the others said they'd
　swing by school while they're at it too」

stage0020_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Those guys are students too,
　alongside their Crusher Team duties」

stage0020_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You all didn't go with them?」

stage0020_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$谷川$$
「Well, about that...
　Thanks to a certain someone pulling something reckless,
　$$ダイ・ガード$$'s repairs are taking forever」

stage0020_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$赤木$$
「It couldn't be helped!
　That was the only way to handle it back then!」

stage0020_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$谷川$$
「Huh? I never said that was you, $$赤木$$」

stage0020_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's about as blatant a jab as it gets...!」

stage0020_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$青山$$
「Anyway, that's the situation,
　so we can't deploy for a while」

stage0020_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$いぶき$$
「In the meantime, NERV asked us
　to assess $$第３新東京市$$'s damage」

stage0020_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$大山$$
「We're used to this kind of work, after all」

stage0020_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I see...
　Then maybe I could...」

stage0020_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$赤木$$
「Whoa there, $$シンジ$$.
　This job's one we at $$２１世紀警備保障$$
　took on from NERV」

stage0020_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$青山$$
「Point is, we don't need your help on this」

stage0020_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$... this might be none of my business,
　but friends matter, you know」

stage0020_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Things might not go smoothly right after transferring,
　but why not take a leap and go for it?」

stage0020_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...He's the one who hates me, though...」

stage0020_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm fine.
　I'm used to being alone」

stage0020_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Did you come to get me?」

stage0020_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$赤木$$
「That girl's an Eva pilot too, huh...」

stage0020_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Her name is $$綾波レイ$$.
　The first Qualified... the first girl...」

stage0020_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミサト$$
「In other words, she's the dedicated pilot
　of the Evangelion Prototype Unit-00.
　She's also $$シンジ$$'s classmate, by the way」

stage0020_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$いぶき$$
「So she's fourteen, same as $$シンジ$$...」

stage0020_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$赤木$$
「That girl... did she leave her parents
　and come here to $$第３新東京市$$?」

stage0020_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Even I haven't been told that much.
　Her whole past is blank, too.」

stage0020_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シンジ$$
（There's something between Father and Ayanami
　that I don't know about...）

stage0020_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シンジ$$
（$$赤木$$ and the others have their own work...）

stage0020_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Office workers work...
　Middle schoolers go to school...）

stage0020_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$シンジ$$
（But $$赤木$$ and the others work by choice...
　I've just got nothing else to do...）

stage0020_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
???
「Is this the right way to the library?」

stage0020_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Who's that...
　I feel like I've seen them somewhere,
　but I can't place it...）

stage0020_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
???
「Thanks.
　Are you a student at Junior High No. 1?」

stage0020_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I only transferred in less than a week ago...」

stage0020_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Sorry.
　I... need to get to school.」

stage0020_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So he's the chosen child...」

stage0020_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$トウジ$$
「What is it, Class Rep?
　You look 20% scarier than usual.」

stage0020_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「It's about the new transfer student, Ikari.」

stage0020_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「Quit playing dumb already.
　You keep glaring at Ikari, so
　everyone else keeps their distance too.」

stage0020_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Now, now, Class Rep...
　$$トウジ$$'s got his reasons for being mad.」

stage0020_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「I know about his sister.
　That's still no reason to take it out on Ikari.」

stage0020_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Reason or not, I don't care!
　I won't forgive him!
　That's all there is to it!」

stage0020_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Analysis pattern blue...
　No doubt about it, $$第５の使徒$$.」

stage0020_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$マコト$$
「The Angel's broken through the first line
　and entered $$第３新東京市$$!」

stage0020_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It comes now, of all times, while the Crusher Team's out...!」

stage0020_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$冬月$$
「Was it wise to send out the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, Ikari?」

stage0020_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Originally, only EVA was meant to face the Angels.」

stage0020_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$冬月$$
「But their power was clearly
　beyond what we'd anticipated.」

stage0020_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It means even $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$ isn't all-powerful.」

stage0020_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$冬月$$
「I see...
　So you staged this whole situation on purpose
　just to confirm that gap.」

stage0020_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「For that case, Unit-00 is being readied too.」

stage0020_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$冬月$$
「Heh... so this gives you a good excuse
　to lift Unit-00's freeze.」

stage0020_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$トウジ$$
「No holding back, hurry it up!
　Or I won't be satisfied!」

stage0020_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$竜馬$$
「What's wrong, $$シンジ$$?
　First time hitting someone?」

stage0020_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You're lucky.
　Your first punch wasn't out of hatred.」

stage0020_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$赤木$$
「Ha... didn't think this manga-style scene
　would actually happen.」

stage0020_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$葵$$
「Sorry to that Kansai-dialect kid,
　but I do want to watch this.」

stage0020_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Don't tease me, big bro, big sis!
　This is about my honor as a man!」

stage0020_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Go on, hit me, new kid!」

stage0020_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Well... he's just an honest guy.
　So, please.」

stage0020_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$トウジ$$
「New kid!
　You want to humiliate me even more?」

stage0020_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Th-that settles the score.
　...Sorry for hitting you, Ikari.」

stage0020_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$トウジ$$
「That makes us pals from today on!
　School's gonna be fun starting tomorrow!」

stage0020_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Well, sure, but today's battle
　wrecked our school...」

stage0020_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$大塚$$
「Understood.
　Then the Far East Branch will take in Unit-01,
　Unit-00, their pilots, and Lt. Col. Katsuragi.」

stage0020_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$大塚$$
「Just to confirm,
　the Crusher Team plans to link up with Londo Bell,
　$$プリベンター$$, and others for joint operations.」

stage0020_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$大塚$$
「And you're fine with the Evangelions
　being deployed there as well?」

stage0020_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$大塚$$
「But if the Angels appear again,
　what will you do?」

stage0020_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If we detect signs of an Angel
　appearing, we'll notify you.」

stage0020_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$大塚$$
「Understood.
　In that case we'll dispatch a unit, Evangelions
　included, to you as our top priority.」

stage0020_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then, once the handover paperwork is done,
　we'll bring Unit-01 and Unit-00, with their
　dedicated equipment, into the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.」

stage0020_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$大塚$$
「Won't you say something to your son?」

stage0020_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There's no need for that.」

stage0020_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$大塚$$
「N-no... that was out of line of me.
　Well then, we'll take charge of NERV's forces.」

stage0020_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「An enhanced Angel... an Unknown visitor...
　The schedule laid out 14 years ago
　is slipping, bit by bit...」

stage0020_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「A rigged world...
　So that is the root of it all...」

stage0020_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$冬月$$
「Ikari... I've brought you a visitor.」

stage0020_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Should I say welcome, I wonder...
　Mister $$ゼロ$$.」

stage0020_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「You, once called the Demon Emperor,
　what business do you have with this NERV?」

stage0020_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Do you desire it as well?
　The world's transformation...」

stage0020_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I see...
　So you are a successor...」

stage0020_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text: ～ $$第２新東京市$$, Municipal Junior High School No. 1 ～

stage0020_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$教師$$
「...Now, before we begin class,
　let's introduce a transfer student from $$第３新東京市$$.」

stage0020_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
Toji
「Name's $$鈴原トウジ$$, and this lot's with me!
　Good to meetcha!」

stage0020_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Our middle school got shut down for a bit,
　so we got reassigned here.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0020_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...I'll report our operation's progress so far.」

stage0020_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You're an impatient one, aren't you...
　Can't you wait for your superior's glass to empty?」

stage0020_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Now that rank no longer means anything,
　there's no hierarchy between you and me.」

stage0020_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「If you're going to call yourself my superior,
　I'd like to see you act like one.」

stage0020_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's such a boring assignment,
　so let me at least enjoy some games and drinks.
　You understand, don't you, honey?」

stage0020_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Quit clicking your tongue at me.
　The cares of this world get mixed into the drink.」

stage0020_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...Can I give my report now?」

stage0020_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'd like you to finish before the next drink arrives.」

stage0020_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Space is showing some slight deviation,
　but it's proceeding roughly as planned.」

stage0020_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「For Japan, I moved forces per your orders,
　but a similar deviation has occurred there too.」

stage0020_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「As for 《$$マーティアル$$》, there's no problem
　seeing it as proceeding on our schedule.」

stage0020_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「So space and Japan both show deviation...
　In your view, is that a dangerous level?」

stage0020_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「To confirm that, I intend to go check
　on the uncertain factor myself.」

stage0020_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Roger that.
　In the meantime, I'll step out for a bit.」

stage0020_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Where do you intend to go?」

stage0020_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「It's about time I say hello to this planet's
　caretaker. Sounds like our showing up sent them
　into a panic, trying to do their job anyway.」

stage0020_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...So this will accelerate things now.」

stage0020_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「The countdown's already begun.
　Let's enjoy the game till the clock strikes zero.」

stage0020_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies.
　It seems I startled you.」

stage0020_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My name is $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'm a $$ＤＥＭ$$ agent, and I currently serve as
　the D-Trader's front desk.」

stage0020_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
Shinji
「I... I'm $$碇シンジ$$.
　Pleased to meet you.」

stage0020_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No need to be so formal with me.
　I'm just a humble robot, after all.」

stage0020_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Robots were originally made
　to serve humanity, more or less.
　Do you know the Three Laws of Robotics?」

stage0020_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One... never attack a human.
　One... absolute obedience to humans.
　One... you may self-defend, but only then.」

stage0020_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So there's a rule like that...」

stage0020_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, only robots with self-awareness
　have troublesome restrictions like these.
　I wonder how it works for artificial humans...」

stage0020_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Artificial human... you mean the EVAs?」

stage0020_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, let's stop this topic here.
　If I speak carelessly, I might get
　crushed for it, you know.」

stage0020_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's work our hardest,
　like a good robot should!
　Let's get fired up today too... Business, business!」
